id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27a2: "...Oh, it's only you. Don't startle me.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2855: "Did you see Sylvando's race? Light as the wind, fast as thunder! And so strong! Splendid!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2861: "...What? Sylvando's gone? He's free as a bird. I've no idea where he went!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2874: "Why, Sylvando. So, have you decided to join our circus troupe?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|287e: "Oh, ringmaster! I'm a wandering entertainer, I have no plans to settle in this kingdom!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|288a: "Hmm, I see. Sylvando turned me down again. How disappointing. Sniff...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2893: "By the way, you're heading out somewhere? A giant scorpion monster has appeared. Do be careful outside.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28a4: "Sylvando is a wandering entertainer, so leaving this land is his sad fate. Still, it's lonely...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28b1: "I pray Sylvando's journey ahead will be brilliant.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a8b: "I hear a man named Sylvando who entered in my place ran amazingly well. The prince, needless to say.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a98: "Ah, how frustrating! What a trial the goddess of racing has given! I wanted to run with Prince Faris!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aa8: "I heard it. You ran for the prince at the Faris Cup. They say it was a fine run.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ab4: "But can you keep up with my speed? ...Heh heh. See you at the track. I look forward to racing you.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bc8: "A wounded soldier was carried toward the castle. I wonder what happened...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bd5: "The prince is going to the Celestial Sands, but he's like that even before leaving. Will he be all right...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2be9: "This is the Kingdom of Gallopolis. The prince's party has left for the Celestial Sands.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bf4: "...The Celestial Sands? Follow the road west out of town to two checkpoints. The north one leads to the dunes.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c06: "But the Celestial Sands is dangerous. If you go, gear up and prepare well first.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c17: "By the way, since the Faris Cup ended, a new race has opened. If you're interested, go to the racetrack.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c29: "Welcome to Gallopolis. As the prince's benefactor, you're welcome anytime.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c48: "...Oh, it's you. Welcome to Gallopolis. Working this late must be tiring.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c50: "People here are lively even at night. Even at this hour, we have to keep watch.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e75: "The prince who showed his gallant form in the race is now going to capture a monster! How reliable!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e87: "The prince who showed his gallant form in the race has gone to capture a monster! How reliable!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e99: "Hey, you! Aren't you the prince's friend who ran in his place at the Faris Cup?!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ea7: "...Oh, wrong person. I'd have been thrilled if it were.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2eb3: "Wow! I'm thrilled! Your run at the Faris Cup was amazing!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2eb9: "Races have resumed, so if you enter again, I'll definitely cheer for you!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3038: "Did you watch the Faris Cup? The prince's gallant ride... just recalling it makes me swoon!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3043: "...What? That wasn't the prince but you?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|304c: "...Hee hee! Stop joking! I could never mistake you for the noble prince!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|305a: "Oh, sorry, I must have misheard. Right! I could never mistake you for the noble prince!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3076: "Oh, you're fighting with Prince Faris? If you join the expedition, try not to hold him back.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3085: "You're fighting with Prince Faris? If you join the expedition, try not to hold him back.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3097: "Listen! Prince Faris left on an expedition! And his target is the infamous desert killer!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30a4: "...What? You're going on the prince's expedition and fighting alongside him?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30bd: "I heard. At the Faris Cup, you ran as the prince.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30c4: "Come to think of it, you somehow resemble the prince, and you're kind of cool... *blush*
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30ce: "Eek, what am I saying! The prince is surely cooler than you!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30dc: "The prince is surely cooler than you! I'll keep cheering for the prince.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30eb: "Waiting for him bothers the prince and I'd like to quit, but it's a habit I can't break.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3281: "When Prince Faris came to the paddock, he looked at me! I'm sure of it! He was looking at me!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3291: "Eek! Prince Faris is going to capture the desert killer!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|329a: "To try to capture the terrible monster that has killed many knights, how brave the prince is...!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32ac: "Prince Faris has gone to capture the desert killer!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32b4: "To try to capture the terrible monster that has killed many knights, how brave the prince is...!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32c6: "We selfishly pressed our ideals on him and never saw the real prince...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32d1: "...But the prince fighting without giving up was so cool. Not what I imagined, but I might be a fan again... *blush*
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32e2: "Coming here at night became a habit, and I come without any reason.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|32eb: "...But if I wait like this, the prince might appear and a romance might begin...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|342e: "The prince won the Faris Cup, proving my eye was right! I feel great! Ha ha ha!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|343e: "Serving the country loyally... it's in the knight's teachings too! Those who revere the prince laugh last!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3452: "I bet everything on the prince winning the Faris Cup... and a mysterious entertainer in his place wins!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3462: "When you're this wrong, all you can do is laugh! Ha ha ha! Ha ha...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3470: "Hey, next year's Faris Cup, the prince will enter properly and win, right?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3480: "Right! You get it. This year's race had a stand-in, apparently, but...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3489: "Seeing the prince's fight with the desert killer, you can tell he's fast on a horse too! No way he loses to Faiz!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|355d: "Faiz dropping out made the Faris Cup a huge upset. I bet on Faiz and lost big...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3568: "But that Sylvando who ran in his place rode like a seasoned knight. No ordinary entertainer could do that.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|357d: "This guy firmly believes the prince will enter properly next year's Faris Cup and win. He's crazy.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3589: "That bravery was admirable, true. But Faiz is on another level. He's the champion, after all.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3676: "Oh... a customer? Sorry. You can't enter the tent yet. If you want the circus, come at night.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36b8: "That Sylvando... I thought he'd wandered off, but he was in the Faris Cup. I was stunned!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36c2: "Only Sylvando in the whole world could get away with such nonsense. ...He's such a free spirit!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36d3: "Oh, Sylvando! You suddenly left, and we were all worried!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36dd: "Oh, sorry! There was something on my mind. I'll be out for a while.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36e4: "...Hmm, is that so. I don't know why, but be careful. After all, you're a star.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36f2: "Sylvando is leaving the circus. Everyone in the troupe is sad.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|36f9: "...What? Circus tickets? Hee hee, come again at night. Something good might happen...?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3709: "Oh, a customer? Sorry. Circus tickets are sold out. Please come again.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3713: "...Just kidding! To celebrate Sylvando beating the desert killer, admission is free now!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|371f: "The troupe will give wonderful shows, so come in freely! Special service, today only!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|372d: "To celebrate Sylvando beating the desert killer, admission is free now! Please come in freely!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3855: "Wow, the Faris Cup was a surprise. Sylvando is not only a great street performer, he's that fast in horse races!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3863: "Even with Sylvando gone, we'll liven up Gallopolis ourselves! Come on, step right up!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3971: "And Sylvando was in the Faris Cup too! He rode a horsie and was amazing!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3981: "Wow, Sylvando! I saw your circus the other day! It was so fun!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3989: "Oh, little one, you watched the show? Thank you! I'm so glad. I'll keep trying, so keep cheering for me.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3992: "Yeah! My dream is to be an amazing person like Sylvando! I'll always cheer for you!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|399f: "Sylvando is amazing! He's fast on a horsie, and strong enough to beat monsters!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a8d: "The Faris Cup was a shock! The entertainer Sylvando from the circus suddenly entered and did wonders!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a9b: "Thanks to that, my child talks only about Sylvando, and the whole family is exasperated.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3aa8: "Oh, Sylvando! My son is your fan. He'd be overjoyed if you talked to him.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ab6: "My child won't stop saying he wants to be a traveling entertainer like Sylvando.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3acf: "My child won't stop saying he wants to be a traveling entertainer like Sylvando.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3abf: "My knight husband wanted our child to be a knight too, so he's a bit jealous. Cute, isn't it?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ad8: "My knight husband wanted our child to be a knight too, so he's a bit jealous. Cute, isn't it?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cd1: "The Faris Cup crowd's excitement was tremendous. I could feel everyone's love for racing. You don't see that often.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3cf6: "But since then, my son has taken a liking to Sylvando and says he wants to be a traveling entertainer.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d01: "And Sylvando did so well in the Faris Cup too, so as a knight I'm conflicted.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d2c: "I hear the desert killer has appeared. We soldiers must stay steady so the people aren't frightened.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d6b: "To defeat the desert killer the knights feared like that. That Sylvando must be an incredible warrior.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d8f: "To defeat the desert killer the knights feared like that. That Sylvando must be an incredible warrior.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d79: "The prince couldn't beat it, but he fought very bravely. We knights must train harder too.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3d9d: "But Sylvando did so well in the circus and Faris Cup that my son likes him even more.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3da8: "He says he wants to be a traveling entertainer someday. As a knight, I'm conflicted.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3eb3: "H-hey, did you see the Faris Cup! Sylvando entered and I was stunned! And so fast too!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ec0: "If I'd known Sylvando was entering, I'd have grabbed the best viewing spot... Damn, so frustrating!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ed3: "S-Sylvando so close... Gah, it's like a dream.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ee0: "Hey, did you see Sylvando's splendid swordplay? It gave me goosebumps.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f26: "Hey, did you see Sylvando's splendid swordplay? It gave me goosebumps.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3eeb: "So I changed my thinking a bit. Instead of chasing Sylvando, I'll become like Sylvando!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f31: "So I changed my thinking a bit. Instead of chasing Sylvando, I'll become like Sylvando!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3ef7: "So I'm here deepening my thoughts on the path of the arts. Someday I'll be a traveling entertainer!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f3c: "So I'm here deepening my thoughts on the path of the arts. Someday I'll be a traveling entertainer!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f07: "Instead of chasing Sylvando, I'll become a traveling entertainer like him! I'm pondering the path of the arts.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f15: "If you meet me on your journey as a traveling entertainer, then, take care of me!

tm.「彼 ケガで苦しんでいるときも\n 遠征に向かわれた 王子さまのことを\n 心配: "Even while suffering from his injury, he worried about the prince who went on the expedition.
tm.「自分よりも 人のため 国のため……。\n まさに 騎士の鏡ですわ。: "Putting others and country before himself... a true model knight.
tm.「わははっ！ やっぱり サーカスは楽しいな！\n 訓練の後だと なおさらだ！: "Ha ha! The circus is fun as always! Even more so after training!
tm.「うん？ このボクに何か用か？\n あいにく 今は忙しい。\n 話なら 後で……: "Hm? Do you need something from me? Unfortunately I'm busy now. Talk later...
tm.「……な なーんだ キミたちか。\n おどろかせないでくれよ。: "...Oh, it's only you. Don't startle me.
tm.「……変わってないじゃないかと 言いたげだな。\n カン違いしてもらっては こま: "You want to say I haven't changed? Don't misunderstand. I'm just taking a break after training.
tm.「キミたちも 羽を休めたい時は\n サマディー王国で 遊んでいくといい。\n 旅: "If you want a rest too, enjoy Gallopolis. Travel fatigue will blow away.
tm.「いや～ シルビアさんのレースを見ましたか？\n 風のような軽やかさ 雷鳴のよう: "Did you see Sylvando's race? Light as the wind, fast as thunder! And so strong! Splendid!
tm.「……え？ シルビアさんがいない？\n 彼は 鳥のように 自由な人ですからね～。: "...What? Sylvando's gone? He's free as a bird. I've no idea where he went!
tm.「ややっ シルビアさん。どうでしょう？\n 我らがサーカス団に 入団する気になり: "Why, Sylvando. So, have you decided to join our circus troupe?
tm.「やだわ 団長ったら！\n アタシは 流浪の旅芸人なんだから\n この王国に 定: "Oh, ringmaster! I'm a wandering entertainer, I have no plans to settle in this kingdom!
tm.「むーん そうですか。\n シルビアさんに またフラレてしまいました。\n 残念: "Hmm, I see. Sylvando turned me down again. How disappointing. Sniff...
tm.「そういえば どこかにお出かけされるようですが\n 大きなサソリのバケモノが 現: "By the way, you're heading out somewhere? A giant scorpion monster has appeared. Do be careful outside.
tm.「シルビアさんは 流浪の旅芸人ですから\n この地を離れるのも 悲しき定め。\n: "Sylvando is a wandering entertainer, so leaving this land is his sad fate. Still, it's lonely...
tm.「シルビアさんの これからの旅路が\n かがやかしいものになるよう 祈ってますよ: "I pray Sylvando's journey ahead will be brilliant.
tm.「ボクの代わりに出た シルビアという男が\n とんでもなく いい走りを見せたらし: "I hear a man named Sylvando who entered in my place ran amazingly well. The prince, needless to say.
tm.「ああ くやしいっ！\n レースの女神は なんたる試練を与えたもうか！\n ボク: "Ah, how frustrating! What a trial the goddess of racing has given! I wanted to run with Prince Faris!
tm.「聞いたぞ。ファーリス杯は\n キミが 王子の代わりに走ったんだってな。\n な: "I heard it. You ran for the prince at the Faris Cup. They say it was a fine run.
tm.「だが ボクのスピードに ついてこれるかな？\n ……フッフッフッ。レース場で: "But can you keep up with my speed? ...Heh heh. See you at the track. I look forward to racing you.
tm.「ケガを負った兵士が\n 城の方へと 運ばれていったが\n 何か あったのだろう: "A wounded soldier was carried toward the castle. I wonder what happened...
tm.「王子さまが バクラバ砂丘へ行かれるそうだが\n 出発する前から あんな様子で\: "The prince is going to the Celestial Sands, but he's like that even before leaving. Will he be all right...
tm.「ここは サマディー王国だ。\n 王子さま一行だったら\n バクラバ砂丘へ 出発: "This is the Kingdom of Gallopolis. The prince's party has left for the Celestial Sands.
tm.「……バクラバ砂丘の場所か？ 町を出て\n 西へ道なりに進むと ふたつの関所が見: "...The Celestial Sands? Follow the road west out of town to two checkpoints. The north one leads to the dunes.
tm.「しかし バクラバ砂丘は 危険な場所だぞ。\n もし 向かうのなら 装備をととの: "But the Celestial Sands is dangerous. If you go, gear up and prepare well first.
tm.「そういえば ファーリス杯が終わって\n 新しいレースが 開幕しているそうですよ: "By the way, since the Faris Cup ended, a new race has opened. If you're interested, go to the racetrack.
tm.「サマディー王国へ ようこそ。\n 王子さまの恩人の あなたでしたら\n いつで: "Welcome to Gallopolis. As the prince's benefactor, you're welcome anytime.
tm.「……おお あなたでしたか。\n サマディー王国へ ようこそ。\n 夜ふけまで: "...Oh, it's you. Welcome to Gallopolis. Working this late must be tiring.
tm.「この国の人々は 夜も元気でしてね。\n こんな時間でも こうして\n 目を光ら: "People here are lively even at night. Even at this hour, we have to keep watch.
tm.「レースで勇姿を見せてくださった 王子さまが\n 今度は 魔物の捕獲へ向かわれる: "The prince who showed his gallant form in the race is now going to capture a monster! How reliable!
tm.「レースで勇姿を見せてくれた 王子さまが\n 今度は 魔物の捕獲へ向かわれたんで: "The prince who showed his gallant form in the race has gone to capture a monster! How reliable!
tm.「やややっ あなた！\n ファーリス杯で 王子さまの代わりに走った\n 王子さま: "Hey, you! Aren't you the prince's friend who ran in his place at the Faris Cup?!
tm.「……なーんだ 人違いでしたか。\n もし そうだったら カンゲキしたんですが。: "...Oh, wrong person. I'd have been thrilled if it were.
tm.「おおおっ！ カンゲキです！\n ファーリス杯での走り スゴかったです！: "Wow! I'm thrilled! Your run at the Faris Cup was amazing!
tm.「レースも 再開したようですし\n もし あなたが またレースに出たなら\n 絶: "Races have resumed, so if you enter again, I'll definitely cheer for you!
tm.「あなた ファーリス杯を ご覧になって？\n ファーリスさまの いさましき走り…: "Did you watch the Faris Cup? The prince's gallant ride... just recalling it makes me swoon!
tm.「……ええっ なんですって？\n あれは 王子じゃなくて 自分ですって？: "...What? That wasn't the prince but you?
tm.「……うふふ！ 冗談をおっしゃい！\n あなたと 高貴な王子さまを\n 私が 見: "...Hee hee! Stop joking! I could never mistake you for the noble prince!
tm.「あら ごめんなさい 空耳だったみたい。\n そうよね！ あなたと 高貴な王子さ: "Oh, sorry, I must have misheard. Right! I could never mistake you for the noble prince!
